items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Johnny somebody. He'd play, he'd do a whole lot of -- Bubber ate him up.

ctx.x: Oh, with Mamie Smith and the Jazz Hounds?

Yeah. With a trumpet player, what was his name? He was a hell of a guy, Bubber had to cut him down to size. Johnny somebody. He'd play, he'd do a whole lot of -- Bubber ate him up. Bubber took his plunger and killed him. Hawk was in the band. That's the first time I saw Hawk, Lincoln(?) Theater, Mamie Smith, a very prominent singer.
